address: Palé Hall, Palé Estate, Llandderfel, nr Bala, Gwynedd, Wales,LL23 7PS
bio: Enjoy a Traditional Afternoon at Tea Pale Hall, a AA Five Red Star nestled in the beautiful Dee Valley.  This Victorian manor is surrounded by 16 acres of picturesque woodland garden and located on the edge of Snowdonia National Park.  You can enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea including a selection of finger sandwiches, and an assortment of homemade patisserie and sweet treats. If you're in an extra decadent mood, why not add a glass of champagne?
